display_name: EMA61 OHLC Zone Reclaim with RSI and Williams %R
description: Long entry after a prolonged period below a 61-session OHLC EMA zone, followed by two completed closes above the zone while daily RSI and Williams %R remain oversold.

deterministic_steps: For each completed daily session calculate EMA61 independently on Open, High, Low and Close.
Define the daily EMA zone lower boundary as the minimum of the four EMA values and the upper boundary as the maximum.
For signal day S, require the ten completed sessions S-11 through S-2 to each close below their own EMA-zone lower boundary.
Require S-1 and S to each close above their own EMA-zone upper boundary.
Require daily Wilder RSI(14) on S to be strictly below 30.
Require daily Williams %R(14) on S to be strictly below -80.
Emit one long entry intent after S closes; fill at the next trading session open under the shared execution model.

assumptions: The phrase 'Williams %R less than 80' is interpreted as Williams %R below -80 under the conventional negative scale.
The ten below-zone closes are the ten sessions immediately before the two confirmation closes.
Both confirmation closes must be above the complete EMA zone, not merely above one of the four EMA lines.
RSI and Williams %R are evaluated on the latest completed confirmation bar.
No exit, stop, timeout or carry rule is owned by this strategy.
provisional_parameters: OSCILLATOR_OBSERVATION_BAR may require a new version if the intended bar was the last below-zone candle rather than the latest confirmation candle.
